name: zfmv_action_image_begin
description: zFMV_ActionImage::Begin lazily resolves the image asset by path and stores the returned image pointer.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV image action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463300 validates the MSVC thiscall Begin hook: load imagePath from offset 8, call zImage::TexDirFindOrCreateByPath through the accepted fastcall dependency, store the returned pointer in image at offset 12, ignore the double start time argument, and return void with ret 8.
The dependency frontier has no visible source blockers; zImage::TexDirFindOrCreateByPath is accepted functional and tier S.
The native smoke patches the image lookup dependency and verifies Begin passes imagePath unchanged, stores the returned image pointer, and ignores the time argument.
